---
title: "AI Studio on Start + Void"
description: "AI Studio Worker identity, acceptance commands, smoke checks and Vercel rollback packet."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

AI Studio (`apps/ai`) runs on TanStack Start, Vite+ and Void with the shared
Start bridge. The native Worker owns `ai.tuturuuu.com`; no route or domain is
declared in source. Production publication remains held until exact-head CI,
sealed emitted-Worker acceptance, staging acceptance and rollback capture pass.
The existing Vercel deployment remains the rollback target until cutover.

## Cutover packet

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Production Worker | `tuturuuu-ai` (`VITE_AI_NATIVE_PROFILE=production`) |
| Staging Worker | the staging Worker name |
| Host | `ai.tuturuuu.com` (operator-attached; no source route) |
| Bindings | `ASSETS` (`dist/client`), `TUTURUUU_NOINDEX=1` in the source config; production artifact policy must be checked in its emitted config |
| Secret names | `TUTURUUU_APP_COORDINATION_SECRET`, `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`; provider credentials are optional: `GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY` or `GOOGLE_API_KEY`, `AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY` or `VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN` |
| Build | `VITE_AI_NATIVE_PROFILE=production bun run --cwd apps/ai build:cloudflare` |
| Prior Vercel deployment | No immutable deployment ID is recorded in the repository. Rex must capture the active AI Vercel deployment ID and URL before cutover. |
| Data | No database writes or migrations are part of this cutover. |

The AI Worker requires the coordination and Supabase secrets at startup. The
build logs only the selected provider category, never credential values.

## Acceptance and smoke

Run the production build and emitted suite from the repository root:

```bash
VITE_AI_NATIVE_PROFILE=production bun run --cwd apps/ai build:cloudflare
CI=true CI_SOURCE_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)" bun run --cwd apps/ai test:runtime
```

After the release owner deploys the accepted artifact and attaches the host,
probe the canonical origin without credentials:

```bash
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null https://ai.tuturuuu.com/
curl -sS https://ai.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://ai.tuturuuu.com/api/build-info
```

Confirm expected page/auth behavior, the exact accepted source SHA in build
info, and `x-tuturuuu-runtime: native`. Smoke both the canonical subdomain and
the `https://tuturuuu.com/ai` mount if that mount is admitted by the cutover.
This packet does not authorize routing or provider changes.

## Rollback

Before switching, Rex records the active Vercel deployment ID, immutable URL,
and routing it serves. If smoke, authentication, error rate or latency regresses,
restore the captured host routing to that Vercel deployment in one step; do not
rebuild during rollback. Retain the Vercel deployment and routing until the
native Worker completes its stable release window.
